title: Journey of a River
lesson: To understand ‘Journey of a River’, begin with the situation presented in the chapter and identify what is happening. Focus on river source and flow and tributaries, then look for evidence for landscapes along a river. Finally, explain what you learned and how the idea can guide a decision or observation outside the chapter.
